Cors._comment: Origins allowed by the production 'YallaJoPolicy' CORS policy (AllowCredentials enabled for SignalR + Web frontend). Wildcard is NOT permitted with credentials, so list explicit origins per environment. Empty array => policy is a safe no-op (no cross-origin browser access). Override in appsettings.{Environment}.json or via Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 env vars.

ExternalAuth._comment: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret between the Web BFF (issuer) and this API (verifier). MUST be supplied via user-secrets or environment variables — at least 32 bytes. The Web project binds the same section name with the SAME SigningKey.

Recaptcha._comment: Google reCAPTCHA v3 bot protection. SecretKey is server-only — set via user-secrets / environment variables. SiteKey is mirrored to the Web project's Recaptcha section for client-side script loading. BypassForTesting must remain false in production.

Retention._comment: Background cleanup of disposable Auth state. Enabled MUST be true on exactly one host (the API host) so the sweep runs from a single place; the Web host sets it false. Session/RefreshToken retention windows keep a short-term security-review surface and preserve refresh-token reuse detection (revoked tokens must remain queryable to catch replays).

Weather._comment: Upstream weather provider config (WeatherAPI.com). To enable, set Provider='weatherapi' and supply ApiKey via user-secrets (dev) or environment variables (prod): Weather__Provider, Weather__ApiKey. Defaults target the WeatherAPI.com Free plan: 100,000 calls/month and a 3-day forecast cap. Raise ForecastDays only on a paid plan (Starter=7, Pro+=300).

ContentBlogs._comment: HMAC-SHA256 key for content_blogs.BlogViews.ViewerHash. MUST be supplied at deploy time via user-secrets / environment variables / key vault (ContentBlogs__ViewerHashSecret). Do NOT check a production secret into source control. The application refuses to start if the value is missing or whitespace. Rotation re-counts every previously-tracked viewer once on their next visit — treat as a deliberate operation.

Booking._comment_UseStubSnapshotReaders: Controls cross-module snapshot readers (tour/provider/pricing). true => XOR-derived fake snapshots (Development convenience so the app boots before inbox handlers populate data). false => real DB-backed readers fed by ContentTours/Accounts integration events. LEFT UNSET here so the environment-based default applies (stubs only when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development); appsettings.Development.json sets true, appsettings.Production.json sets false explicitly.
